messages:
sam_new: Hey team, first day here! Followed the onboarding and installed Homebrew + asdf but I also tried Nix because I like reproducible envs. Now my shell is confused: `node` comes from nix, `python` from asdf, and pipx CLIs are nowhere. My dotfiles try to source both nix and asdf. Any recommended ordering or minimal dotfile snippet for macOS (zsh) that keeps Nix and asdf playing nicely? Do we use Nix here at all?

tara: welcome Sam! we don't mandate Nix company-wide but some folks use it. Typical zsh ordering I put in ~/.zprofile: 1) Homebrew paths for apple silicon, 2) asdf init, 3) user local bin. If using Nix, source its profile after asdf so asdf shims stay first, e.g.:
```bash
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH
. "$(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh" || true
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
# Nix profile (optional, put after asdf shims)
if [ -f "/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/etc/profile.d/nix.sh" ]; then . /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/etc/profile.d/nix.sh; fi
```
This keeps asdf-managed runtimes first.

devx_ben: +1. Also run `asdf reshim` after installs. For pipx prefer installing into asdf python: `python -m pip install --user pipx && pipx ensurepath`. If you use Nix to provide tools, expect them to shadow user installs unless their profile is later in PATH.

infra-bot: Dev env doc: <internal/dev-setup/macos-asdf-nix.md>. Reminder: do not commit secrets into dotfiles.

sam_new: great, that helps. My dotfiles currently source asdf in ~/.zshrc not zprofile; should I move it? Also how do I check which shim is resolving a command?

tara: move init to ~/.zprofile (login shells on mac). To inspect resolution: `which -a node python pipx` and `type node` and `ls -l $(which node)` to see symlink to asdf shims. `asdf where node` isn't a command but `asdf current` shows versions.

devx_ben: one more tip: if you have old pyenv/rbenv remove them to avoid multiple shims. `brew uninstall pyenv rbenv` and `rm -rf ~/.pyenv ~/.rbenv` if you don't need them.

sam_new: thanks everyone 44d I'll reorder my dotfiles and reinstall pipx into asdf python. If anything breaks I'll paste outputs. Appreciate the quick help!
